summaryZh: 以源图配色的左侧撕纸托起真实摄影主体，右侧留白容纳衬线标题与短句，配少量胶带和同源版画纸片。
summaryEn: Anchor a photographic subject on source-colored torn paper, balancing pale space, classical serif copy, translucent tape and a small engraved echo.
sampleTitleZh: 橙色罂粟与鼠尾草绿花瓶
sampleTitleEn: Orange poppies in a pale-sage vase
samplePrompt: Create one original photorealistic still-life photograph, portrait 2:3, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Three open orange poppy flowers with delicate translucent orange petals and dark centers, plus one closed green bud, on slender natural green stems arranged in one small matte pale-sage ceramic vase. The whole vase and the flower heads are visible, with coherent stems attached to the flowers. Simple warm off-white plaster backdrop and a small natural wooden tabletop, soft side daylight, true photographic fine detail and natural shadows. Calm uncluttered composition, flowers centered with room around the arrangement. No typography, collage, paper effects, labels, logos, border or watermark. This is a synthetic original source photograph for a later image-editing demonstration.
samplePromptZh: 独立生成一张2:3竖版真实静物摄影：三朵橙色开放罂粟花、一个绿色闭合花苞及自然相连的细茎叶，插在完整的小型淡鼠尾草绿哑光陶瓷瓶中。暖白灰泥墙和木桌，柔和侧窗光，花头与瓶底完整，不含文字、拼贴、纸张效果、标志或水印。
samplePromptNoteZh: samplePrompt保留实际原图调用；中文为对应说明。示例文案另行创作，不是来源帖原文。
samplePromptNoteEn: samplePrompt retains the actual source-generation call; Chinese text describes it. Example copy is newly authored, not quoted from the post.
sampleTextNoteZh: 标题与短句为本次示例独立拟写，其他输入应根据实际画面更换。
sampleTextNoteEn: Title and observation are independently written for this sample; replace them with content grounded in each actual input.
sampleAnalysis: 已目视原图：三朵橙色开放罂粟花、一个绿色闭合花苞和相连的自然茎叶，插在完整淡鼠尾草绿陶瓷瓶中；暖白墙、木桌，2:3竖版，无文字或标志。
mediumAnchor: A portrait photographic collage on torn dyed paper, balancing an intact realistic subject with pale editorial space and restrained serif typography.
mediumAnchorZh: 以撕裂染色纸承托真实摄影主体，配浅色编辑留白和克制衬线排版的竖版拼贴。

fragments.text: Make one portrait 2:3 photographic collage poster, viewed straight on as a flat scan, regardless of the source aspect ratio.
For an isolated subject, extract a faithful photographic cutout; for a complete scene, retain essential surroundings inside a torn-edge photograph.
Sample dominant, supporting and dark colors from the photograph for dyed paper, accents and lettering; retain a warm-white background.
Cover the left 60–68 percent with one large irregular dyed-paper shape; keep the right side pale and spacious.
Place the photographic subject large at left-center; let small contour sections cross the dyed-paper edge without entering the text area.
Set two short title lines at upper-right in a high-contrast classical serif: upright first line, italic second line.
Choose title words that name visible content or its setting; use supplied wording when available and avoid generic motivational slogans.
At middle-right, arrange a six-to-twelve-word English observation in three to five left-aligned lines of serif italic.
Place one small subject-derived silhouette above that observation and one fine vertical rule to its left.
Use warm-white fibrous paper, exposed pale torn cores and soft contact shadows; preserve fine photographic texture within the main subject.
Add exactly two translucent beige tape pieces: one at the upper-left and one at the lower-right.
At lower-left, angle a warm-white torn scrap bearing a monochrome vintage engraving interpretation of the same photographed subject.
At lower-right, overlap two or three small coordinated paper scraps, leaving the observation and main photograph unobstructed.
Apply only light wear; keep the result clean, tactile and legible, with no outer frame, tabletop presentation or watermark.
Remove unrelated source-layout text; introduce only the two-line title and short observation, with no extra captions, dates, brands or labels.

fragmentsZh: 输出一张2:3竖版摄影拼贴海报，以正面平整扫描视角呈现，不默认沿用原图比例。
单体使用忠实的摄影抠图；完整场景保留必要环境，以撕边照片承载。
从原照提取主色、辅助色和暗色，分别安排染色纸、装饰和文字，背景保持暖白。
左侧60–68%放置一大片不规则染色纸，右侧保持浅色留白。
摄影主体在左中部放大，少量轮廓越过染色纸边，但不侵入文字区域。
右上标题分两行，每行使用短词；采用高对比古典衬线，第一行正体、第二行斜体。
标题指向画面可见的内容或环境；有用户指定文案时优先使用，避免泛泛的励志口号。
右侧中部排一条6–12个英文词的画面相关短句，分3–5行，以衬线斜体左对齐。
短句上方加入一个源自主体的小剪影，左侧配一根细竖线。
呈现暖白纤维纸、浅色撕裂纸芯和柔和接触阴影，主图内部仍保留细致摄影质感。
左上和右下各加一条半透明米色胶带，共两条。
左下斜放暖白撕纸，承载同一摄影主体的单色复古版画式小图。
右下叠放2–3张协调的小纸片，不遮挡短句和摄影主体。
只作轻微旧化，保持干净、可触的纸感与文字可读性，不出现外框、桌面陈列或水印。
移除输入中无关的版式文字；新增文字仅限两行标题和短句，不加说明、日期、品牌或标签。
preserve: Preserve observed subject identity, count, proportions, pose, attachments and relationships; scaling and placement within the poster may change.
Keep the main subject photographic; preserve necessary environmental context for scenes instead of isolating disconnected scenery.
Only the small silhouette and lower-left engraving may echo the main subject; these are graphic decorations, not additional photographic subjects.
Derive colors and wording from the actual input; orange flowers and a sage vase belong only to this example.
preserveZh: 保留实际主体身份、数量、比例、姿态、连接和物间关系；允许调整海报内的大小与位置。
主图保持真实摄影；场景输入保留必要环境，不把景物拆成无关联抠图。
仅小剪影和左下版画可复现主体，二者是装饰图形，不是新增的摄影主体。
颜色和文案依据实际输入决定，橙花与绿瓶仅属于本示例。
negative: Cartoon rendering of the main photograph, distorted bodies or objects, missing subjects, changed poses, disconnected stems or arbitrary new scenery.
White sticker outlines, heavy drop shadows, thick borders, strong yellow stains, excessive grime, glossy dimensional mockups or framed tabletop displays.
A fixed indigo palette regardless of the source, text covering the subject, crowded right-side space or additional promotional copy.
Invented brands, dates, logos, signatures, watermarks, unrelated graphics or source-layout text unrelated to the photographed content.
negativeZh: 主图卡通化、人物或物体变形、主体缺失、姿态改变、茎叶断连或任意添加场景。
白色贴纸描边、厚重阴影、粗边框、强烈黄污、过度脏旧、亮面立体样机或带框桌面陈列。
无视原图固定用靛蓝、文字遮挡主体、右侧拥挤或额外营销文案。
虚构品牌、日期、标志、签名、水印、无关图形，或保留与摄影内容无关的原版式文字。
paletteNoteZh: 色卡仅对应橙花、绿瓶及深色花心示例；暖白纸底保持克制，实际主色、辅助色和深色来自输入。
paletteNoteEn: Swatches describe the orange flowers, sage vase and dark centers; keep a restrained warm-white paper ground and derive actual colors from the input.
geometryNoteZh: 实际输出固定为2:3竖版；单体可抠图并等比缩放，场景保留必要环境并加撕边。允许轮廓轻微越过左侧纸边，但不改变身份、姿态、比例和主体关系。小剪影与版画是明确允许的同源装饰。
geometryNoteEn: Output a portrait 2:3 poster. Isolated subjects may be extracted and uniformly scaled; scenes retain essential context inside torn photo edges. Small contour overlaps do not change identity, pose, proportions or relationships. The silhouette and engraving are permitted source-derived decorations.
acceptanceZh: 输出为2:3竖版，左侧60–68%染色纸与右侧浅色留白明确；主体身份、数量、比例、姿态和连接保留，主图保持摄影细节和必要环境。
纸张、装饰和字体色来自原照，暖白纸有纤维、浅色纸芯和柔和接触阴影；仅轻旧化，不见白描边、重阴影或黄污。
右上两行古典衬线标题首正次斜；中右短句6–12个英文词、3–5行左对齐，剪影在上、细竖线在左，无额外文案。
两片米色半透明胶带位于左上和右下；左下斜纸承载同源单色版画，右下有2–3片协调纸；无相框、桌面样机或水印。
acceptanceEn: A portrait 2:3 result balances a left 60–68 percent dyed-paper field with pale right space; identity, count, proportions, pose, attachments and necessary photographic context remain intact.
Paper, accents and lettering follow the source palette; warm-white fibers, pale torn cores and soft contact shadows show only light wear, without white outlines, heavy shadows or yellow grime.
Two classical serif title lines use upright then italic; a six-to-twelve-word observation spans three to five left-aligned lines below a silhouette and beside a fine rule, without additional copy.

Two translucent beige tapes sit at upper-left and lower-right; an angled lower-left engraving scrap and two or three lower-right scraps complete the layout, without frames, tabletop mockups or watermarks.
